name: XlPivotCellType
description: Specifies the PivotTable entity to which the cell corresponds.

constants.name: xlPivotCellValue
constants.description: Any cell in the data area (except a blank row).

constants.name: xlPivotCellPivotItem
constants.description: A cell in the row or column area that is not a subtotal, grand total, custom subtotal, or blank line.

constants.name: xlPivotCellSubtotal
constants.description: A cell in the row or column area that is a subtotal.

constants.name: xlPivotCellGrandTotal
constants.description: A cell in a row or column area that is a grand total.

constants.name: xlPivotCellDataField
constants.description: A data field label (not the Data button).

constants.name: xlPivotCellPivotField
constants.description: The button for a field (not the Data button).

constants.name: xlPivotCellPageFieldItem
constants.description: The cell that shows the selected item of a Page field.

constants.name: xlPivotCellCustomSubtotal
constants.description: A cell in the row or column area that is a custom subtotal.

constants.name: xlPivotCellBlankCell
constants.description: A structural blank cell in the PivotTable.
